practice.prompt: Two complementary angles: one is 30°. Find the other.
Complementary angles sum to A 90°, B 180°, C 360°.
practice.solution: By definition their measures add to 90°.

practice.prompt: An angle is x° and its complement is 28°. Find x.
Complementary angles measure x° and 2x°. Find x.
Angles (3x+12)° and (x+18)° are complementary. Find x.
Complementary angles measure 0.5x° and x°. Find x.
One complementary angle is 7° larger than the other. Find the smaller angle.
Complementary angles are in ratio 2:3. Find the smaller angle.
practice.solution: Five parts equal 90°, each part 18°, so smaller=2×18=36°.

practice.prompt: Angles (3x+5)° and (2x+10)° are complementary. Find x.
Angles (4x−6)° and (2x+12)° are complementary. Find x.
One angle is 12° less than twice its complement. Find the smaller angle.
practice.solution: Let complement=b; other=2b−12. Then 3b−12=90, b=34 and other=56.

practice.prompt: An angle is 20% of its complement. Find the smaller angle.
Angles (5x+10)° and (x−4)° are complementary. Find x.
Complementary angles have ratio 5:7. Find the smaller angle.
practice.solution: Twelve parts total 90°, one part 7.5°, so 5 parts=37.5°.

practice.prompt: A right triangle has acute angles (3x+5)° and (x+9)°. Find the larger acute angle.

test.prompt: Angles (4x+10)° and (2x+20)° are complementary. Find x.
Complementary angles are in ratio 2:7. Find the smaller.
test.solution: Nine parts total 90°, each part 10°, smaller=20°.

test.prompt: One angle is three times its complement. Find the larger angle.
Angles (5x−3)° and (2x+9)° are complementary. Find the larger angle.
